test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 28 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is NOT correct about the Pacific ring of Fire?

options.text: It is a belt of active volcanoes.
75% of Earth's volcanoes are located along the Ring of Fire.
The Pacific Rim covers the eastern shores of North America and South America.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The Pacific Rim covers the eastern shores of North America and South America**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pacific Ring of Fire**

 
 
• The** Pacific ring of fire or the circum-Pacific belt** is another name for the Ring of Fire.
 
• **Volcanoes along that stretch of the Pacific Ocean are extremely active**, and earthquakes happen frequently there.
 
• The **majority of earthquakes and volcanic eruptions** are recorded in and near the Ring of Fire.
 
• It is roughly **40,000 km long**.
 
• **75% of Earth's volcanoes** are located along the Ring of Fire.
 
• The significant tectonic plates that surround the area are responsible for the** high frequency of earthquakes**.
 
• At convergent boundaries known as **subduction zones**, plates cross each other.
 
• They are related to **deep trenches**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Pacific, Juan de Fuca, Cocos, Indian-Australian, Nazca, North American, and Philippine Plates **are just a few of the tectonic plates that it follows as it delineates boundaries between them.
 
• The Pacific Rim includes the western coasts of North and South America, as well as the coasts of Australia, eastern Asia, and the Pacific islands.
 
• The** majority of the planet's earthquakes**, including the most severe and dramatic seismic events, happen along its path.
 
• Two-thirds of all volcanoes in the world, or 850–1,000, are located in the Ring of Fire and have erupted recently.
